title: Write a critique
description: Critique a claim with concession, rebuttal, and academic tone.

items.prompt: Write a short critique (6–8 sentences) of a policy or research claim.
items.promptIt: Scrivi una breve critica (6–8 frasi) di una politica o di una tesi di ricerca.

items.prompt: Transform two informal verb phrases into nominalised academic forms.
items.promptIt: Trasforma due frasi verbali informali in forme nominalizzate accademiche.
hints: sales improved → an improvement in sales
